caption: Inserting 8, 3, 10, 1, 6 and 14 in that order. Each value walks the path a search would, and goes where it runs out.

steps.title: insert 8
steps.caption: The tree is empty: 8 becomes the root

steps.title: insert 3
steps.caption: 3 < 8, go left. 8 has no left child, so 3 goes there

steps.title: insert 10
steps.caption: 10 > 8, go right. 8 has no right child, so 10 goes there

steps.title: insert 1
steps.caption: 1 < 8, go left. 1 < 3, go left. Empty, so 1 goes there

steps.title: insert 6
steps.caption: 6 < 8, go left. 6 > 3, go right. Empty, so 6 goes there

steps.title: insert 14
steps.caption: 14 > 8, go right. 14 > 10, go right. Empty, so 14 goes there
